shops.name: Adventurers' Store
shops.desc: Kit for people who expect to sleep outdoors and be shot at. Packs made up by trade, ready to be shouldered and walked out with.

shops.name: Alchemists & Apothecaries
shops.desc: Jars of things that help and, behind the counter, a few that do not. The proprietor will ask what you need it for and may not believe the answer.

shops.name: Arcane Store
shops.desc: Quiet, warm, and further inside than the frontage suggests. Focuses and components openly; wands and scrolls for those who can pay and be trusted with them.
shops.note: Spellcasting here draws on the arcane lists. How much a caster will part with in a day is finite: roll 1d4+1 slots in a village, 1d8+1 in a town, 1d12+1 in a city. Spells with expensive components that work without the caster are listed by name, with the components in the price; for any other spell, add the cost of any expensive components you don't bring.

stock.n: Spellcasting: Protection from Evil and Good

Jeweled Horn or Glass Eye (100 GP)
Amulet of Proof against Detection and Location

shops.name: Armourer & Blacksmiths
shops.desc: Hot, loud, and busy from before dawn. Blades and plate made and mended, and the only place in a small settlement that can shoe a horse and hammer out a helm.

shops.name: Criminal & Illicit Store
shops.desc: No sign, no fixed hours you would admit to knowing, and a door that is answered rather than opened. Pays badly, charges dearly, and asks nothing at all.

shops.name: Dock
shops.desc: Tar, rope and shouting. Passage bought at the quayside, and for those with far more money than sense, a hull of their own.

shops.name: Druidic Store
shops.desc: Bundles drying overhead and a floor of trodden rushes. Sells what grows, to people who know what to do with it.
shops.note: Spellcasting here draws on the primal lists. How much a caster will part with in a day is finite: roll 1d4+1 slots in a village, 1d8+1 in a town, 1d12+1 in a city. Spells with expensive components that work without the caster are listed by name, with the components in the price; for any other spell, add the cost of any expensive components you don't bring.

stock.n: Spellcasting: Protection from Evil and Good

shops.name: Fletcher & Woodworker
shops.desc: Staves seasoning in the rafters and arrows counted into bundles of twenty. Bows to order, and shafts by the dozen for anyone who shoots often enough to lose them.

shops.name: General Store
shops.desc: The shop everyone uses for everything: rope, lamp oil, a cooking pot, a length of chain. Nothing here is remarkable, which is the point.

shops.name: Inn & Tavern
shops.desc: Beds upstairs, a fire downstairs, and a landlord who has heard every story twice. Rooms by the night at whatever standard you can stomach paying for.

shops.name: Jeweler
shops.desc: A narrow counter, a good lamp, and a strongbox bolted to the floor. Buys stones and worked metal at a fairer rate than most, because they know what it is worth.

shops.name: Leatherworker
shops.desc: Hides curing out back and the smell to prove it. Boots, belts, jerkins and the straps that hold everything else together.

shops.name: Musical Store
shops.desc: Somebody is always tuning something. Instruments hang by their necks along one wall, and the maker will happily play each one at you before you choose.

shops.name: Stable
shops.desc: Straw, flies and the warm smell of horse. Beasts sold, hired and boarded, with tack to match and feed by the day.

stock.n: Coach Ride within a City (per mile)

shops.name: Tailor & Textile Store
shops.desc: Bolts of cloth stacked to the ceiling and a tailor who can tell your station from your hem. Everyday wear off the shelf, finery to measure.

shops.name: Temple & Faith Store
shops.desc: Not a shop so much as a counter beside the door, where the faithful leave coin and take away what the temple can spare. Healing draughts, holy water, a symbol to carry.
shops.note: Spellcasting here draws on the divine lists. How much the temple will part with in a day is finite: roll 1d4+1 slots in a village, 1d8+1 in a town, 1d12+1 in a city. Spells with expensive components that work without the caster are listed by name, with the components in the price; for any other spell, add the cost of any expensive components you don't bring.

stock.n: Spellcasting: Protection from Evil and Good

shops.name: Tinkering Store
shops.desc: Every surface covered, nothing thrown away. Locks, hinges, bell-pulls and small mechanisms of unclear purpose, plus the tools to make more of them.
